analysis:
The only changed file is docs/developer/build.md, a documentation-only update. The date header moves from 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-19. The CI workflow table at head lines 358-361 is rewritten, and the hourly dev-run section (base lines ~360-395) is replaced by opt-in PR CI and GPU shard text at head lines 363-396. The head text now says that CI (dev) PR runs and macOS test suites on master PRs need one-shot `run-ci` or `run-gpu-ci` labels. It also says `threat-model-review.yml` runs on master PRs only with the `run-threat-model` label, and that darkbloom-route retries and the watchdog stay bounded. No runtime, provider, authorization, attestation, encryption or key-handling code changed, so TB-002, TB-003, TB-011 and the App Attest assets are untouched.

The one security-relevant observation is process-level. Making the trusted PR threat-model review opt-in via a label (head lines 379-381) reduces automatic review coverage on master PRs. That is a CI governance choice that is outside the supplied evidence for the workflow files, so I cannot tell whether branch protection or other required checks compensate. The docs also say Release Integrity and Docs Lint still run automatically on master PRs (head lines 361, 371). The actual workflow YAML changes live in other batches. The next pass should check that the label-gating change in `.github/workflows/threat-model-review.yml` and `ci-master.yml` matches this documentation. In particular it should check that label handling cannot be triggered by untrusted fork actors and that a required security gate is not silently skipped. I found no concrete regression in this documentation-only unit. Patch excerpt is truncated, but the displayed head text covers the changed region up to line 396.
